Zur deutschen Version Roche at a glance 100 000 + collaborators worldwide 125 + years of innovation 39 million patients treated with our medicines in 2025 Roche is a healthcare company uniquely placed to prevent, stop and cure diseases by uniting leading science and technology across diagnostics, medicines and digital solutions. The company was founded in Basel, Switzerland in 1896 and today is a leading provider of transformative medicines and diagnostics for millions of people in over 100 countries around the world. It is dedicated to tackling healthcare challenges that place the greatest strain on patients, families, communities and healthcare systems. Across its Diagnostics and Pharmaceutical divisions, Roche focused on areas including oncology, neurology, cardiovascular and metabolic diseases, ophthalmology, infectious diseases and immunology with the aim of providing real and positive change for patients, the people they love and the professionals who care for them. Transcript Making a real difference to people's health. That's what drives us. We're not here to do what's easy. We work to provide real and positive change for patients, the people they love, and the professionals who care for them. For generations, we have dedicated ourselves to tackling healthcare challenges where our impact matters most. Our focus is on areas like oncology, neurology, and cardiovascular and metabolic diseases. Conditions like these place the greatest strain on patients, families, communities, and healthcare systems around the world. Detecting diseases earlier and understanding them better means we can provide patients with the right treatments quicker. This is how our life-changing diagnostics and medicines help people live healthier, longer lives. And we are persistent. We keep going even in the toughest areas of research, and we learn from the experiences of those living with disease every day. Because of all of this, we are finding new ways to make a difference. From developing tests to diagnose conditions like neurological disorders and cancers before symptoms occur, to delivering first-of-their-kind medicines that halt and even reverse diseases in areas from autoimmunity to metabolic health. We are also making treatments more accessible and available closer to patientsâ homes. We are determined to prevent, stop and cure diseases. Not someday, but now.
